openings.claim: Replace magnetic attraction with a mounting-slot-supported mechanical pocket: three steel strips contact unmarked boundaries; overlapping lips resist lift; the fourth strip pivots as keeper closing the removal route. Use drilled strip holes, bolts, cork pads and a releasable wire latch. Keeper stays attached; open it and grip an unmarked area for inspection.
openings.discriminator: With sufficiently small gaps and adequate stiffness, the spare may remain within 1 mm over twenty strokes despite weaker magnetic pull. Magnets alone depend on the supplied 3 N versus 7 N release difference. Pocket drift should track gaps or keeper deformation rather than magnetic strength; this relationship is unmeasured. Defeat: excessive gaps/flex, lift escaping lips, keeper release, or gloved removal/return exceeding sixty seconds.
openings.probe: Map slots, clearance, exposed edge and removal route using ruler/marker. Proceed only if M4 attachment, strip reach/formability and gloved unmarked grip fit. Never drill, cut, heat or glue plate/carriage; expose marked 30 mm edge; no added part enters marked stroke clearance; carriage stays on rails. Compare at most two configurations: magnets alone and pocket. One twenty-stroke run per plate per configuration, spare last; mark starting positions and measure displacement. Time one removal/return per plate per configuration, gloves for spare; inspect keeper opening and strip deflection. Respect eighty fabrication/twenty observation minutes and caps of three twenty-stroke runs and three service checks per configuration. Incomplete timed evidence cannot qualify.
openings.uncertainty: Slot dimensions, strip stiffness/formability, available overlap outside clearance and safe grip access are unknown. Stroke forces are unknown; magnetic-rival failure is possible, not established. Geometry and performance remain proposed, unverified.

lineage.reason: Preserves pocket mechanism, allocation, rival prediction, defeat conditions, fit uncertainty and bounded geometry/service probe.

decision: Probe only after every hard constraint passes geometry screening; reject fabrication otherwise. Unknown resources cannot justify relaxed clearance, edge exposure or carriage attachment. No demonstrated retention or service performance.
